text:
amelia: Quick thread  RateGlide trial ends Fri. Need billing clarity before procurement signs a 12mo commit. Can someone paste the sanitized invoice and flag any lines that won't map to our ingestion?
rohan: Pulled from their portal. Two odd bits: a per-request parsing fee and a blended "interaction" SKU for mobile clients.
mica: paste the sanitized lines pls so we can map to SKUs.
rohan: Snippet (sanitized):
```
RATEGLIDE INTERACTION-BUNDLE: 420 interactions @ $0.60/interaction = $252.00
RATEGLIDE BATCH-TOKENS: 1,040,000 tokens @ $0.0006/token = $624.00
RATEGLIDE EMBEDS: 9,800 vectors @ $0.0017/vector = $16.66
RATEGLIDE PARSE-FEE: 35 parses @ $2.50/parse = $87.50
REGIONAL SURCHARGE (EUR): $11.00
TOTAL = $991.16
```
amelia: Procurement issues: 1) we need a CSV price sheet with stable sku_id fields; 2) confirm PO + Net60 terms; 3) which lines count toward commit minimum?
sophie (RateGlide): Hi all  thanks for the snippet. Short answers: we'll provide a machine-readable CSV with sku_id, unit, unit_price, currency, counts_toward_commit. PO numbers + Net60 are available for 12mo commits >= $80k ARR. Interaction-bundle lines are counted toward commit only if marked as "billable_interaction" in the CSV (we can toggle).
mica: How do you define "interactions" vs token billing? Our billing model is per-token and per-embed separately; bundles are messy for our ETL.
sophie (RateGlide): Interaction-bundle is intended for low-latency mobile flows where we charge a single unit per UX interaction (includes small compute + avg token delta). We can split interaction lines into equivalent token+operation lines in the CSV to ease mapping, or keep both and include a mapping file.
rohan: Tokenization mismatch is common. Our tokenizer shows ~4% fewer tokens on sample logs. Will you accept Redwood counts for reconciliation?
sophie (RateGlide): We use a BPE-compatible tokenizer. We will provide a tokenization script and sample outputs. We can sign a reconciliation addendum to accept Redwood counts as authoritative for billing reconciliation; it requires a 2-business-day audit SLA and an initial cross-check. We'll draft the addendum for legal review.
amelia: Trial credits: we used $2,500. Do those apply to commit minima or just as first-invoice credit?
sophie (RateGlide): Trial credits are applied as a one-time invoice credit on conversion and do not reduce commit minimum calculation. We can discuss a one-time concession for a multiyear commit.
procurement-bot: Reminder: Vendor risk questionnaire pending  RateGlide shared link: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/rateglide Assigned to @mica and @legal.team. Deadline 4 business days.
mica: Two other items: 1) can you emit invoice_line_id (stable UUID per line) so our ingestion can dedupe? 2) do you offer usage webhooks/NDJSON events?
sophie (RateGlide): Yes on both. We'll include invoice_line_id as a column in the CSV and provide a daily gzipped NDJSON export plus a near-real-time webhook for usage events. We'll attach schema docs.
amelia: Overages and discounts? Need table for commit tiers and overage behavior.
sophie (RateGlide): Tier example: 12% off list for $60k+ ARR, 20% for $140k+, 26% for $320k+. Commits billed monthly with quarterly true-ups. Overage billed at list with a year-over-year cap of 10% on rate increases. Unused commit spend is credited as invoice credit at year-end.
rohan: VAT/tax: will you support EU reverse-charge and include VAT_ID field in the CSV? Also do you invoice in EUR?
sophie (RateGlide): Yes, we support EUR invoicing and will include VAT_ID and tax_summary columns on every invoice CSV. Reverse-charge applied when VAT ID is provided.
mica: SLA + data residency for Dedicated purchases? We need details for procurement.
sophie (RateGlide): Hosted: 99.9% uptime SLA. Dedicated/reserved pools: 99.95% with optional multi-region redundancy. For Dedicated we support customer-managed KMS and can host in eu-west-1 for EU residency. SOC2 Type II summary available under NDA.
amelia: Ok next steps: @sophie please upload CSV price sheet with sku_ids and unit mapping, attach tokenization script and a draft reconciliation addendum, include invoice samples with invoice_line_id, and confirm Net60+PO policy in writing if commit >= $80k. @mica/legal will triage the vendor risk form. If we get the CSV today I'll run a 60-day cost projection and post results here before EOD.
sophie (RateGlide): Uploading now  I'll follow up with a formal quote showing the tiered commit math and the reconciliation addendum draft. Happy to join a 20m call to walk through the CSV.
rohan: Thanks all. If reconciliation addendum is acceptable we can automate our ingestion and avoid manual fixes at renewal. :thumbsup:
